text:
Sam (sales): POC kickoff tomorrow SG. Client pinned model "redwood-max-v3" and getting MODEL_NOT_FOUND from ap-sg, then 429s. Need fast triage, a 14-day dedicated trial price, and short security answers for compliance. Logs below.

Alex (se): Paste the exact request and the error id. Did they pin by name or manifest id?

Sam (sales): They used literal "model: \"redwood-max-v3\"". Proxy snippet (redacted):
[2027-01-05T22:11:02Z] id=dd77a model=redwood-max-v3 region=ap-sg status=404 err=MODEL_NOT_FOUND msg="variant deprecated/not staged"
[2027-01-05T22:11:03Z] id=dd77b model=redwood-max-v3 region=ap-sg status=429 err=NO_FALLBACK msg="route missing"

Pri (infra): Quick root cause: canonical artifact flagged as deprecated in APAC - not staged. Options:
- Enable alias fallback: map pinned name -> redwood-max-v3-quant or redwood-max-v3-compat (deployed ap-sg).
- Push manifest to ap-sg (if they insist on exact artifact) - ~24-48h.

Jules (security): Compliance asks: KMS separation, SOC2, and regional log residency. Hosted covers SOC2 + encryption; Dedicated/Private required for guaranteed egress restriction. I can prepare a one-page answer.

Alex (se): Short-term workaround: if customer signs off we flip account-level alias and they add header `x-allow-fallback:1` for the POC. Note: quant variant may change latency/quality. Example:
POST /v1/generate
Headers: {Authorization: Bearer <key>, "x-allow-fallback": "1"}
Body: {"model":"redwood-max-v3","input":"..."}

Infra-bot: Deployment check:
- redwood-max-v3: manifest M-z9x1 deployed: eu-west, us-east (deprecated in ap-sg)
- redwood-max-v3-quant: manifest M-z9x1-q deployed: ap-sg (replicas:3)
- redwood-max-v3-compat: manifest M-z9x1-c deployed: ap-sg (replicas:2)

Pri (infra): Ballpark infra cost for 2x A100-eq for 14 days ~ $9k-$13k. Recommend quoting $17k-$19k including monitoring & ops. Alias fallback can be enabled in ~60-90m once we have written consent.

Sam (sales): Contact: rachel.tan@exampleasia.com. I'll ask if they accept fallback or require exact parity. Need security pack + quote asap.

Billing-bot: Draft quote prepared: $18,000 for 14-day dedicated trial (2x A100-eq) including monitoring and a single point of contact. Finalize with Finance if they want adjustments.

(20m later)

Sam (sales): Customer accepts fallback for the POC with written note about quality differences. Please enable and monitor.

Pri (infra): Enabling alias mapping now for acct-701: pinned=redwood-max-v3 -> redwood-max-v3-quant in ap-sg. Will smoke-test and report.

Infra-bot: Alias applied. Test calls returning 200; watching for 429 spikes.

Alex (se): Good. Sam, send Rachel the security one-pager and the quote. If they later require exact artifact we schedule a manifest push (24-48h).

Sam (sales): Will do. Closing loop with customer. Thanks all.
